legenda: Juneau advisory ballot question on long-range surface access north, October 2000.
nota: O resultado oficial da eleição municipal de outubro de 2000 da CBJ (fonte primária) não foi aberto; o número é do estudo, que cita o Final EIS de 2006.
narracao: That October, Juneau voters split almost evenly. Better ferries finished just 79 votes ahead of a road.

conferencia.prova: "In October 2000, Juneau voters were split on an advisory ballot question … with 5,840 choosing enhanced ferry service and 5,761 choosing a road." (o estudo cita o Final EIS de 2006)
